Tumhara samay seemit hai, ise kisi aur ki zindagi jeene mein barbad mat karo.
Shuruaat karne ka tareeqa hai ki baatein band karein aur kaam karna shuru karein.
"Jeet ya haar—tum yaad kiye jaoge."
Jo tumne chaha hai, wo darr ke us paar hi hai.
Hope passive nahi; act karti hai.
Momentum tumhara dost hai.
"Agar fly nahi kar sakte, toh run."
Tum kabhi bhi old nahi hote, goal set karne ke liye.
High achievers perform mode mein sochte hain.
